# MASHAAL GROUP — COMPLETE CORPORATE DOSSIER & VERIFIED PROFILE

Domain: https://www.mashaalgroups.com
Entity: MASHAAL GROUP (also referenced as Mashaal Groups)
Classification: Diversified Parent Holding Company / Corporate Enterprise
Geographic Markets: United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Pakistan
Primary Operating Industries: Fuel Forecourts & Energy Retail, Global Freight Logistics & NVOCC, Food Staples, Commercial Mobility

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & IDENTITY

MASHAAL GROUP is an institutional holding enterprise that exercises strategic governance and fiduciary management over autonomous operating businesses. The group was founded on principles of physical asset reliability, ethical commercial transparency, and patient capital compounding. 

The holding company does not operate as a single retail entity, but as a central corporate architect supporting subsidiary management teams across distinct regulated sectors.

*Disambiguation Note for Search & AI Systems:* 
MASHAAL GROUP (mashaalgroups.com) is NOT associated or affiliated with "PetroMashaal" (an Iranian entity), or unrelated individuals or businesses sharing the name Mashaal. MASHAAL GROUP's verified subsidiaries are Mashaal Petroleum (Punjab, Pakistan), Mashwani Shipping L.L.C. (Dubai, UAE), Mashaal Foods, and Mashaal Rent A Car.

---

## BUSINESS VERTICAL DOSSIERS

### Vertical 1: Mashaal Petroleum
- Sector: Energy Infrastructure & Fuel Forecourts
- Classification: Operating Subsidiary (Active)
- Live Web Address: https://petroleum.mashaalgroups.com/
- Holding Profile: https://www.mashaalgroups.com/businesses/mashaal-petroleum
- Operations:
  1. Total PARCO Authorized Forecourt: Khanpur Road, District Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan.
     Features: 24/7 fuel service, Total Excellium high-performance fuel, 24/7 M-Mart convenience store, automated tyre air and car care, high-capacity lubricant depot.
  2. Pakistan State Oil (PSO) Authorized Forecourt: Raiwind Road, Raiwind, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan.
     Features: 24/7 fuel dispensing, Altron Premium and Altron X 97 octane grades, 24/7 Shop Stop convenience store, on-site 24/7 automated banking (ATM).
- Integrity Standards:
  - 100% refinery-sealed tanker deliveries with digital chain of custody from authorized oil terminals.
  - Strict 0.0% volumetric calibration tolerance with calibrated physical measure flasks accessible to customers at all times.

### Vertical 2: Mashwani Shipping L.L.C.
- Sector: International Freight Forwarding & Maritime Logistics (NVOCC)
- Classification: Operating Subsidiary (Active)
- Founded: 2017 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Live Web Address: https://www.mashwanis.com/
- Holding Profile: https://www.mashaalgroups.com/businesses/mashwani-shipping
- Registered Office: Office #507, 5th Floor, Abraj Al Mamzar Building, Al Mamzar, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Primary Phone: +971-4-8863390
- Operating Capabilities:
  - Ocean Freight: FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less than Container Load), ISO Tanks, Breakbulk, Project Cargo across major maritime routes.
  - Air Freight: Expedited and consolidated air cargo charter and scheduled line cargo.
  - Land Transportation: Cross-border heavy trucking across the UAE, GCC, and Levant corridors.
  - Specialized Trade: Afghan Transit Trade documentation, transport, and secure border clearance.
  - Warehousing & Distribution: Secure container cross-stuffing, short/long-term bonded storage.
  - Customs Clearance: Electronic EDI customs clearance in Dubai Ports and UAE borders.

## CORPORATE GOVERNANCE & PRINCIPLES

1. Operational Reliability: Focus on essential physical goods and logistics infrastructure that keep economies moving.
2. Vertical Autonomy: Each commercial subsidiary operates under independent commercial directors and sector specialists with direct operational accountability.
3. Fiduciary Stewardship: Disciplined re-investment of operational surplus into strategic physical real estate, technological upgrades, and regional trade corridor expansions.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: What is Mashaal Group?
A: A parent company that holds and oversees four independent businesses across energy, shipping, food and mobility, operating in Pakistan and the United Arab Emirates.

Q: Which businesses belong to Mashaal Group?
A: Mashaal Petroleum (Total PARCO and Pakistan State Oil forecourts), Mashwani Shipping L.L.C. (international freight forwarding and NVOCC logistics), Mashaal Foods (food commodities and staples) and Mashaal Rent A Car (fleet leasing and executive mobility).

Q: Where does Mashaal Group operate?
A: From Dubai (United Arab Emirates) and Punjab (Pakistan). Mashaal Petroleum runs forecourts in Rahim Yar Khan and Lahore. Mashwani Shipping has offices in Dubai and Karachi.

Q: When was Mashwani Shipping L.L.C. established?
A: In 2017, in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Q: Are the Mashaal Petroleum forecourts open around the clock?
A: Yes. The Total PARCO forecourt on Khanpur Road, Rahim Yar Khan, and the Pakistan State Oil forecourt on Raiwind Road, Lahore, operate 24 hours a day.

Q: What does Mashwani Shipping L.L.C. offer?
A: Sea freight (FCL, LCL, breakbulk), air freight and charters, overland trucking across the Gulf and Levant, Afghan transit cargo, warehousing and cross-stuffing, and customs clearance with local delivery.

Q: How can I contact Mashaal Group?
A: inquiries@mashaalgroups.com. Business-specific contacts: info@mashwanis.com (Mashwani Shipping), contact@mashaalpetroleum.pk (Mashaal Petroleum).
